description: Implementation of WifiManagerSignalThreshold class managing WiFi signal strength monitoring, including signal polling, threshold setting, and thread control.

classes.name: WifiManagerSignalThreshold
classes.description: Class managing WiFi signal strength threshold monitoring, including thread management and signal polling.

methods.name: retrieveValues
methods.description: Executes a command to retrieve the RSSI value from WiFi interface.

methods.name: getSignalData
methods.description: Retrieves current signal strength and categorizes it as Excellent, Good, Fair, or Weak.

methods.name: stopSignalThresholdThread
methods.description: Stops the signal threshold monitoring thread.

methods.name: setSignalThresholdChangeEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables signal threshold change notifications and manages thread start/stop.

methods.name: isSignalThresholdChangeEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether signal threshold change notifications are enabled.

methods.name: loop
methods.description: Main thread loop polling signal strength at specified intervals.

methods.name: setSignalThresholdChangeEnabled
methods.description: Sets the enabled state for signal threshold change notifications.

methods.name: startThread
methods.description: Starts the monitoring thread with specified interval.
